title: CLOTH YOUR HOME
IN HIS LOVE
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer
stock_queries: warm wooden table with open Bible and glowing candle
quiet olive branch on rustic wooden surface with warm lamp light
peaceful countryside home illuminated by warm evening window light
soft morning sunlight through window on a quiet family dining table
warm hearth fire glow in a calm and peaceful living room
serene evening prayer atmosphere with soft warm ambient lighting

scenes.a: If tension at the dinner table still lingers in your chest, pause with us now.
Lord, where impatience took root today, we ask You to soften every heart under this roof.
Your Word commands us: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
Wrap every family member in that perfect love, binding us together through every disagreement.
And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
Father, let that quiet gratitude overflow in our household tonight.
